['Daimler Truck Holding AG '].company_description: Daimler Truck Holding AG, also known as Daimler Truck AG, is one of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers. It operates in various locations worldwide and has approximately 100,000 employees. Daimler Truck AG was previously a part of Daimler AG and was spun off as an independent company in December 2021. The company is headquartered in Leinfelden-Echterdingen, Germany. Daimler Truck AG offers a range of commercial vehicles, including trucks and buses, under various brands such as Mercedes-Benz, Freightliner, and FUSO.

['Bayer AG '].company_description: Bayer AG is a German multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company. It operates in the areas of pharmaceuticals, consumer healthcare products, agricultural chemicals, seeds, and biotechnology products.
